cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ninlil_vendor_verification C)
get_filename_component(NINLIL_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(LIBEDHOC_ENABLE_MODULE_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LIBEDHOC_LOG_LEVEL 0 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${NINLIL_ROOT}/third_party/libedhoc" vendor)
get_target_property(sources backend_cbor SOURCES)
set(adapted "")
foreach(source IN LISTS sources)
  get_filename_component(name "${source}" NAME)
  list(APPEND adapted "${NINLIL_ROOT}/third_party/adapted/cbor/${name}")
endforeach()
set_property(TARGET backend_cbor PROPERTY SOURCES "${adapted}")
get_target_property(sources zcbor SOURCES)
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/zcbor_encode\\.c$")
list(APPEND sources "${NINLIL_ROOT}/third_party/adapted/zcbor_encode.c")
set_property(TARGET zcbor PROPERTY SOURCES "${sources}")
get_target_property(sources libedhoc_module_tests SOURCES)
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/edhoc_cipher_suite_2\\.c$")
list(APPEND sources "${NINLIL_ROOT}/third_party/adapted/edhoc_cipher_suite_2.c")
set_property(TARGET libedhoc_module_tests PROPERTY SOURCES "${sources}")
